items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: Ed Marsh used to sit crossways for some old reason. He never did play this way with the band.

ctx.x: Did many guys sit funny when they played? Or wiggle around?
Well, Ed Marsh used to sit crossways for some old reason. He never did play this way with the band. He always played his horn this way.
